title: Expanded, deduplicated public TV library
notes: Adds credential-free public FAST/FTA catalogues for Pluto, Samsung, Roku, Tubi, LG, Vizio, Whale TV+, Xiaomi, Xumo, Local Now, VIDAA, Fire TV, TCL and Free-TV. The library now contains 13,765 unique channels and 131,364 real guide entries, with duplicate names/URLs removed and 1,147 confirmed dead, login-gated or invalid endpoints quarantined. Existing favourites, folders, hidden channels, settings, add-ons and logins are preserved; the catalogue refresh runs once in the background after the interface is responsive.
